title: Young gymnast carries Yulo's words to heart in Dakar YOG stint
summary: Fueled by the wise words of double Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo, a teenage gymnast is looking to make the country proud at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar.
